children: The yen strengthens against other G-10 and Asian currencies as risk aversion takes hold, StoneX's Matt Simpson says in commentary. "Rising equity market volatility and deteriorating risk sentiment are raising questions about whether yen-funded carry trades are beginning to unwind," the senior market analyst says. "Further deterioration in risk sentiment could accelerate these moves," particularly against more volatile currencies such as the Australian dollar, Simpson adds. The U.S. dollar falls 0.3% to Y159.26, the Australian dollar slips 1.0% to Y105.97 and the euro declines 0.2% to Y174.73. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
